findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_platform · Private data: search_platforms, get_platform, whoami, create_project, record_submission · Public sink: search_platforms, get_platform, whoami, submission_playbook, list_submissions · Destructive: qualify_project, whoami, plan_submissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_platform · Private data: search_platforms, get_platform, whoami, create_project, record_submission · Public sink: search_platforms, get_platform, whoami, submission_playbook, list_submissions · Destructive: qualify_project, whoami, plan_submissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
